The click handler uses `nearbySearch` with a 50m radius and may return routes. Updating it to prioritize establishments and exclude routes:


---

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="search_replace">

<details><summary>Tool use: **search_replace** • Edit file: src/components/Map.tsx</summary>

**Chunk 1**
Lines added: 2, lines removed: 2

```diff
@@ -47,6 +47,6 @@
        const request = {
          location: event.latLng,
-         radius: 50, // Search within 50 meters
-         type: "establishment",
+         radius: 100, // Increased radius to 100 meters for better detection
+         type: ["establishment", "point_of_interest", "restaurant", "store", "food"],
        };
  
```

**Chunk 2**
Lines added: 39, lines removed: 4

```diff
@@ -57,8 +57,43 @@
            results.length &gt; 0
          ) {
-           // Get the closest place
-           const place = results[0];
-           if (place.place_id) {
-             onPlaceSelect(place.place_id);
+           // Filter out routes and other non-place types
+           const validPlaces = results.filter((place) =&gt; {
+             const types = place.types || [];
+             // Exclude route types
+             return !types.some(
+               (type) =&gt;
+                 type === "route" ||
+                 type === "street_address" ||
+                 type === "premise" ||
+                 type === "subpremise"
+             );
+           });
+ 
+           if (validPlaces.length &gt; 0) {
+             // Calculate distance and get the closest valid place
+             const clickedLat = event.latLng!.lat();
+             const clickedLng = event.latLng!.lng();
+             
+             const closestPlace = validPlaces.reduce((closest, current) =&gt; {
+               const currentLocation = current.geometry?.location;
+               const closestLocation = closest.geometry?.location;
+               
+               if (!currentLocation || !closestLocation) return closest;
+               
+               const currentDist = Math.sqrt(
+                 Math.pow(currentLocation.lat() - clickedLat, 2) +
+                 Math.pow(currentLocation.lng() - clickedLng, 2)
+               );
+               const closestDist = Math.sqrt(
+                 Math.pow(closestLocation.lat() - clickedLat, 2) +
+                 Math.pow(closestLocation.lng() - clickedLng, 2)
+               );
+               
+               return currentDist &lt; closestDist ? current : closest;
+             });
+ 
+             if (closestPlace.place_id) {
+               onPlaceSelect(closestPlace.place_id);
+             }
            }
          }
```

Updated the click handler to prioritize places over routes:

1. **Increased search radius** from 50m to 100m
2. **Added filtering** to exclude route types (`route`, `street_address`, `premise`, `subpremise`)
3. **Distance calculation** to select the closest valid place to the click

When you click near a restaurant marker, it will:
- Search within 100 meters
- Filter out routes and addresses
- Select the closest valid establishment

This should fix the issue where clicking on restaurants was selecting routes instead.
